Create a dramatically better CHOOSE YOUR PURSUIT screen: thick sophisticated gunmetal/navy military arcade housing with restrained amber and cyan lights, rich integrated typography, a bold decorative heading, two generous visually separated equal choice cards. LEFT CARD: large faithful Storm Cannon in top-down northwest three-quarter view with blue reactor energy, integrated chunky metallic lettering exactly 'STORM CANNON', smaller text 'LEFT ROUTE'. A coherent broad area of rural American farmland, winding two lane county roads, small isolated neighborhoods with detached homes, red barns, silos, fenced fields, cornfields, pasture, broad forest strips and a winding freshwater creek with little bridges. outputs.name: thruster
outputs.prompt: FRAME FORMAT: Exactly sixteen individual 128x256 RGBA sprite cells, arranged as a perfectly aligned 4 columns by 4 rows sheet (512x1024), zero gutters and no borders. Identical cell dimensions, one proportional scale, fixed nozzle attachment pivot at x64 y224 in EVERY cell. Use case: stylized-concept, production 16-frame seamless blue-white jet thruster animation for an enormous metallic reactor-powered aircraft. Only the isolated exhaust plume, no engine or hull or scenery. The source/nozzle mouth at bottom center (64,224) remains rigidly fixed; a narrow brilliant white core with cyan, electric blue and deep-blue edges jets UPWARD from it, with traveling Mach-diamond rings and finely serrated tongues. Leave at least12px transparent margins at the top and sides, 24px below the nozzle mouth. Sixteen genuinely different ordered phases of steady running thrust: ripples and diamonds travel away from the attachment point, fine sparks leave the plume, length pulses smoothly from about160 to190px while the base stays fixed. End-to-start phase must loop naturally; no start-up, no shut-down, no blank frames. Fine crisp 16-bit pixel art, coherent blue/white limited palette and hard-edged pixels; no blur, no Gaussian glow, no haze, no labels, no frame numbers, no typography, no checkerboard. Actual transparent background.

Frame the single full comic panel with a thin cream-and-black ink border. No dialogue box, no speech balloons, no extra captions, no extra words or people. Preserve reference identity and its deliberate pixel shading; no photorealism or smooth painted texture.
